answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7933 Country: India Title: My name is Khader Basha, please confirm me is it right according to islam? But I am Joined in Tablique I have changed my name as a Abdul Qadir ? Please confirm is it right or not? Question: My name is Khader Basha, please confirm me is it right according to islam? But I am Joined in Tablique I have changed my name as a Abdul Qadir ? Please confirm is it right or not? Answer ID: 7933 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1218/204=TL/1429) It was better that you changed your name to Abdul Qadir, this name is better than Qadir Pasha. Shaikh Abdul Qadir Jilani is a well-known pious personality. May Allah make you also like him! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
